scope: Prospective end-to-end three-resolution CAMO-Pyramid implementation; does not alter or overwrite frozen S0, S5, S7, or S7 test artifacts.
hypothesis: A two-transition 4096->1024->256 measure-aware encoder with sparse row-softmax coarsening, local operators at all resolutions, S7 mass-aware global proxy attention at 256, and transport-plan adjoint decoding is a viable end-to-end pyramid candidate.

architecture.coarsening: frozen S5 row_softmax; sparse fixed support; no dense [N,M] costs
architecture.global_block: frozen S7 mass-aware MHA at 256 proxies only
architecture.decoder: weighted adjoint pullback through each exact encoder plan, fused with saved same-level encoder features
architecture.objective_candidate: BCE_PLUS_0.5_LOVASZ (frozen S2/S7 objective; training not yet authorized)
architecture.test_policy: No S8 test split evaluation until architecture and all confirmatory decisions are frozen; S7 test results may not tune S8.

dry_run: no dense [N,M] or N^2 operation above N=4000
allocated CUDA memory <= 3200 MiB at the frozen batch/shape
gates.pilot: Requires a separately hashed pilot authorization before training; pilot data are validation only and cannot open test data.
gates.confirmatory: Requires a separate pre-registration after pilot; at least three paired seeds for internal gates and five paired seeds for any headline claim, with frozen validation and full-cloud evaluation rules.
gates.hardware: If the exact B=8, 4096->1024->256 dry-run exceeds 3200 MiB or produces non-finite values, stop and revise architecture through a new prospective mutation before training.

non_claims: This registration is not evidence that the architecture improves segmentation.
This registration does not claim SROT; S5 row-softmax is the validated selected coarsening control.
This registration does not authorize S8 training, confirmatory runs, or any new test-set evaluation.
